note: A clean git merge DUPLICATED an idea-registry row. Absorbing 242 commits of main into campaign/the-winze produced two MAP-underworld-floors-and-branches rows -- the branch stale copy beside main post-Drift one -- with no conflict marker and no complaint from git. The idea registry is a hand-edited table, not a generated aggregate, so the never-text-merge-an-aggregate habit does not fire for it; the only thing that caught it was cli/tests/suite/docs_consistency.rs registry_ids_are_unique at gate-commit. After any large absorption that touches the registry, run gate-commit BEFORE building on the merge -- and if you edit a row in the same pass, the duplicate can hide behind your own diff.
